title: Re-verification pass — 14 November 2026
lede: Every value this site publishes was re-read on 2026-11-14 against the live official source that the site cites for it. Rows are reported as found: confirmed, moved, still in conflict, partially confirmed, or honestly not re-checked in this pass. Nothing was inferred, and nothing was quietly refreshed without saying so.
method: Each row below is one live fetch of an official URL on 2026-11-14 — the manufacturer's own product page, the manufacturer's own manual PDF, Amazon's Associates Central help nodes, or Amazon's own response to a request. Verdict vocabulary: confirmed = the official page states what the site publishes; partially-confirmed = the part of the value readable from the document re-read today matches, and the remainder comes from a page this pass did not re-open; moved = a live figure changed since 2026-11-13 exactly as the point-in-time rule predicts; conflict-live = two official pages still disagree and the site still asserts neither; new-evidence = a test no earlier pass ran; not-rechecked = this pass did not re-open that document, so the 2026-11-13 record stands unchallenged and unconfirmed by this pass.
scope_note: Covers the 43 specification rows published from data/products.json, the three price rows, the three brand-rating rows, the commission row, five programme-rule rows and the six link-resolution tests. The parallel builds in s2/, site/, dashboard/, research/ and session-3740f69d/ keep their own verification records and were not re-checked in this pass.

link_resolution.question: Do the three supplied link.amazon tokens resolve to the three ASINs this site documents?
link_resolution.answer: Yes — and the dispute raised by a parallel session is now closed on the evidence. Four independent sessions over two days, using fresh requests each time, obtained exactly B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R and B08DKYBTPH. A nonsense control token is refused outright with 403 rather than being shuffled to some featured product, and the 9-character tokens 404 when pasted straight into /dp/ (they are not ASINs). What remains unproven is the Associates tag riding inside the short link and who created the mapping — not the destination.
link_resolution.evidence_note: Every landing URL still carries lv=shuf&…&plpRedirect=mhFallback, i.e. Amazon's fallback handler. Before any campaign goes live, replace these three short links with canonical tagged /dp/<ASIN>?tag=<your-tracking-id> URLs built inside Associates Central, then re-run this pass.

changes_made: Filled the two Chefman 8 Qt rows that were blank on 2026-11-13: Wattage (1700 W / 120 V) and Dimensions / weight (15.4 × 12.6 × 13.5 in, 12.8 lb) — both are stated outright on the manufacturer's own page, which the earlier pass had not read down to its Specifications block.
Refreshed the two volatile brand-site review counts (1,302 → 1,305 and 715 → 716) and stamped both with both read dates.
Retired the 'target shuffles per request' clause of flag F-07: not reproducible, and contradicted by the nonsense-token control (403 vs product page).
Corrected the executive summary's hardcoded source and flag counts, which had gone stale (12 vs the 22 sources now registered).
Made every published build reachable from the landing page navigation (site/ and dashboard/ were orphaned).
Replaced the false line 'No items resolved yet — this build is the first verification pass' on the Flagged page with an actual resolved-items table.

No other session's work was discarded in the rebase onto main (which had meanwhile taken arena/1dcaaafc's PRs #18-#21): their F14-F18 flags are kept and this pass's three flags renumbered F19-F21; their '0 verified product identities' headline and 'candidate ASIN (unconfirmed)' labels are kept; their link-check report is linked from both the dashboard and the re-verification page. The disagreement — their 'identity not confirmed' versus this pass's 'destination is reproducible' — is published as flag F21 for the owner to arbitrate rather than resolved by vote.
